FN-DGEYITH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 585
Committee: Financial Services Sponsor: Representative Jennifer Fidler
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/17/2026
House Bill 585 as introduced would impose a fee of 1.5% on each outgoing international wire
transfer conducted by a money transmission business, on or after January 1, 2027 and ending
December 31, 2030. This bill would require all fees collected to be: (1) deposited into the Wire
Transfer Fund, established pursuant to the provisions of this bill, within the Alabama Securities
Commission; (2) transferred to the Office of Prosecution Services (OPS) to be distributed to the
Sheriffs' Advancement in Education, Technology, and Training Fund, less an administrative fee
retained by OPS of up to 2%; and (3) allocated to sheriffs pro rata, by the Sheriff's Association,
based on the amount of fees collected in each county and to be used to offset any expenses
incurred by the office of sheriff.
Additionally, this bill would reduce income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an
undetermined amount for Fiscal Years 2028 through 2031 dependent on the amount of income
tax credits claimed, for tax years beginning on and after January 1, 2027 and ending December
31, 2030, in an amount equal to the total amount of all fees collected on outgoing international
electronic wire transfers or $5,000, whichever is less.
This bill would increase obligations of the Legislature by an estimated $2,250 per meeting of the
Legislative Review Committee established by this bill for travel and per diem to meetings to
review expenditures of international electronic wire transfer fee proceeds.
This bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund from fines; increase receipts to the
State General Fund, county general funds and other funds to which court costs are deposited;
and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, the Bureau of
Pardons, Paroles and the Department of Corrections, and community corrections programs by an
